analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. The visible changed ranges are the "Last updated" date (line 3) and CI-runner wording in two places (head 1243-1244 and 1808-1811). The 1808-1811 wording moves macOS CI routing from literal Blacksmith runners to routed lanes. It states that release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners. The supplied units are the base excerpt at lines 2773-3107 and the head excerpt at lines 1-456, so neither the changed regions nor the new link target `build.md#ci-runner-routing` is visible to me. The patch excerpt is complete, and nothing in it changes source code, key handling, attestation, encryption, the coordinator-to-provider WebSocket, cache storage, or authorization behavior. The base excerpt covers test documentation for cluster prefix SSD checks. It is unchanged context and touches T-041 only descriptively. No threat-model assumption (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, T-041) is invalidated by this diff. The only open integration question is whether the CI routing change affects release-signing trust. The documentation says release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners, so signing and release stay on those runners. Any real CI workflow changes would be in other files, outside this batch. A documentation-only change gives no evidence of a regression.
